I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this beans plot because it is too costly and my beans grow well with the cow dung I spread from my animals. I plant the same local bean seeds I have saved from previous harvests, and my family will do all the weeding and harvesting by hand since the plot is small enough for us to manage. We depend only on the rain here in the North West, so I cannot irrigate, and I do not use sprays because I cannot afford them and prefer to pull weeds myself.
